proposed_new_observables.question: At the start of the forward swing, how far does the racket head trail behind the hitting hand?

At the contact frame, how far is the ball from the hitting-side hip, side to side?
At the end of the preparation turn, is the body weight mainly over the back foot, between the feet, or over the front foot?

Scapular retraction of the dominant shoulder during late preparation
Curvature of the spine when bending down to hit

At and through contact, does the non-hitting arm extend backward away from the hitting arm or remain passive / drop down?
Direction of maximum racket velocity vector relative to horizontal through the hitting zone
Direction of footwork recovery after hitting a baseline shot
Player movement transition toward the net after an aggressive shot
Speed of the racket head through the forward swing into contact
Distance between feet during ready stance or recovery

Height of ball trajectory clearance over the top of the net tape
At the start of the forward swing, width of the base of support between the feet relative to shoulders
Serve return attempt outcome when the ball passes untouched
Racket tip lag and wrist layback extension during the transition into forward swing
